Provides summary table with Critical interval and standard deviation within the set.

Source: R/summary_CI_sdev.R
summary_sd_CI.Rd

For each protein state: the pooled replicate standard deviation of all peptides and time points (each peptide's SD weighted by its replicates minus one), and the critical interval of that state alone (CI_single()) using the state's average number of replicates.

Usage

summary_sd_CI(filepath, replicates = NULL, alpha = 0.01)

Arguments

filepath

filepath to the input file. Input file is All_results table from HDX_Examiner, where all the fields are marked for export. Can also be a DynamX cluster/state export, or a table from read_hdx() / as_hdx_long().

replicates

optional maximum number of replicates per state. Default NULL uses every replicate.

alpha

critical interval, to have more restrictive use lower values, default=0.01

Value

Returns summary table.

Examples

file_nm<-system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
a<- summary_sd_CI(file_nm, alpha=0.01)
